notes: fix-79 completed: DiplomacyAI design doc compliance. Refactored applyProposeTreaty to use proper treaties.ts flow (proposeTreaty/acceptTreaty) instead of directly creating active treaties. Added TODO for AI acceptance formula implementation per relationship-formulas.md §9.1.

worker_output.summary: Reviewed diplomacyAI.ts for design compliance. Fixed three issues: (1) applyProposeTreaty was creating treaties directly with isActive=true, bypassing the proper propose/accept flow from treaties.ts — now uses proposeTreaty() + acceptTreaty() for AI-to-AI, pending for AI-to-player; (2) DiplomaticDecision.treatyType was missing, causing propose_treaty actions to always apply non_aggression instead of the intended treaty type (trade/research/etc.); (3) cloneRelation in treaties.ts crashed on missing incomingProposals — now defensive with nullish coalescing. Added test fixture fix for missing incomingProposals field. Verified existing honorable/peaceful trait handling correctly implements design doc rules for war declaration.
